name: How do I know if water leaking from a wall is a serious problem?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if water leaking from a wall is a serious problem?

acceptedAnswer.text: Any water leaking from a wall should be considered a serious problem, as it can lead to significant structural damage, mold growth, and compromised indoor air quality. Signs that indicate a serious issue include a strong musty odor, visible mold spots, warped or discolored drywall, peeling paint, or a significant increase in your water bill. Even a small, slow leak can cause extensive hidden damage over time, making prompt professional assessment essential to prevent escalation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Any wall leak is serious. Signs like musty odors, mold, warped drywall, or a high water bill indicate significant issues requiring immediate professional attention.
